calls.title: Intake Meeting: Director of Demand Generation & Developer Advocate roles
calls.summary: Growth Book is strategically positioned for rapid expansion following the acquisition of competitors, which enhances its market opportunity. The company has experienced robust revenue growth, finishing the last fiscal year with $8 million ARR and aims to achieve over $100 million in three years, focusing on enterprise sales and marketing. Financially stable with over two years of runway after raising Series A funding, Growth Book is targeting sectors like fintech, edtech, and healthtech, prioritizing product teams as buyers. The marketing organization is lean, utilizing contractors and agencies, while plans to expand the demand generation team are underway. The ideal candidate for demand generation must have technical marketing experience specifically oriented towards product and engineering teams, reflecting the company's collaborative culture focused on mentorship and strategic clarity.
calls.keywords: Demand Generation, Enterprise Sales, Product Marketing, Developer-Focused Marketing, Growth Strategy, Candidate Recruitment
